decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9601. Series context: trend strength 0.6066 and seasonal strength 0.3473; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.329); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.376.
